name: Velocitra
description:
Velocitra brings Claude the world's largest athletics (track & field) database of athletes (+800k), competitions, results, season bests, world rankings, records, Elo ratings, and race / mark-probability models.

Ask in plain language, for example, head-to-heads between athletes, meet results, historical records, “Armand Duplantis progression from the 2018”, “who’s in form”, or “what’s the chance they run sub-10.00 in 100m”. Claude uses Velocitra tools instead of guessing from data

Connection requirements:
- A Velocitra account (Google sign-in when you connect) 
- Access from Velocitra: athletics:mcp:read for data tools; athletics:mcp:predictions for race simulation and mark probability 

Contact info@velocitra.com for scope access

_published_faq.name: How do I add Velocitra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Velocitra to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.velocitra.com/v1/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Velocitra MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Velocitra lists 29 MCP tools, including compare_athletes, convert_performance, get_athlete, get_athlete_rating_history, get_competition, get_competition_weather, get_docs, get_event_codes, get_height_table, get_mark_probability, get_on_this_day, and get_other_records.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Velocitra?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Velocitra in data-analytics on the Manufact MCP catalog include Epicure, Newsflash, Point Topic, Pricing Optimizer AI, and StatCite.
Velocitra requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Velocitra is developed by Velocitra Oy. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
